name: Ratlami Sev
ingredients_raw: Chickpea Flour (45%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Contains one or more of the followings: Palmolein, Rice Bran, Corn, Cottonseed), Moth Bean Flour, Seasoning [Edible Common Salt, Spices & Condiments (White Chilli, Ginger, Clove, Pepper, Carom Seed, Cumin, Compounded Asafoetida (Wheat Flour, Gum Acacia, Asafoetida))]. Allergen advice: Contains wheat flour.
